name: Siemens Ltd
title: Siemens Ltd - 500550 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record ₹450bn backlog and Q6 orders up 33%, but EBITDA margin fell 290bp to 9.7% on commodity and Euro-driven material cost (74% of revenue); price hikes lag 3–4 months.

capex.quote: we are examining the expansion requirements for our mobility factories, both in Nashik as well as in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

triggers.label: Material cost 69% → 74% of revenue
triggers.quote: In quarter 2, the material cost was reported as 69% of revenue. And in quarter 6, the number went up to 74%.

triggers.label: New orders +33% YoY in Q6
triggers.quote: New orders moved strongly to INR 67.3 billion, up 33% year-on-year

triggers.label: EBITDA margin 12.6% → 9.7%
triggers.quote: EBITDA margin moved from 12.6 to 9.7, down 290 basis points.

triggers.label: Inventory build and receivables up
triggers.quote: we increased our inventory levels also based on the West Asia crisis

triggers.label: Mobility factory expansion under review
triggers.quote: we are examining the expansion requirements for our mobility factories

guidance.quote: we are not giving guidance on the next or the future quarters

red_flags.label: Margin compression from commodity and FX
red_flags.quote: EBITDA margin moved from 12.6 to 9.7, down 290 basis points.

red_flags.label: Cash conversion slipping; contract assets up
red_flags.quote: our contract assets are going up

red_flags.label: Value adjustments on 9K HP loco order undisclosed
red_flags.quote: We haven't disclosed the value adjustment numbers

evasions.topic: Backlog value after loco value adjustment
evasions.quote: So, we will come back to you with this number. We don't have it offhand.
it would probably be in the range of 12 to 15 or so.
I will not be able to give you specifics about our strategic plans over the next couple of years.
